# Idea to Saas

> Autonomous B2B Micro-SaaS Idea-to-App Pipeline & Validator

## Core Overview
- Domain: https://ideatosaas.vercel.app/
- Category: Developer Tools / B2B SaaS Pipeline
- Mission: Scrapes high-intent market signals from Reddit, Hacker News, and Dev.to, filters out saturated clichés, and generates production-ready micro-SaaS blueprints with live interactive previews and sniper go-to-market strategies.

## Key Capabilities
- Live Market Signal Harvester: Multi-source real-time intent extraction.
- Anti-Repeat Blacklist Shield: Prevents duplicate concept fatigue.
- Sniper GTM Engine: Generates context-aware, 1-click launch replies.
- Spec & Architecture Generator: Full SPEC.md blueprints for Next.js SaaS builds.

## Canonical Links
- Web App: https://ideatosaas.vercel.app/
- Source Code: https://github.com/oguzemirtopuz/ideatosaas
